title: Crash when opening Material Testers demo
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.5.dev 215acd52e
- Not reproducible in: 4.4.1.stable

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev 215acd52e - Fedora Linux 41 (KDE Plasma) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (nvidia; 570.133.07) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-13900K (32 threads)

- Open the project in the editor.
